services.name: rassyclaw
command: set -eu; cfg(){ openclaw config set "$1" "$2" --strict-json >/dev/null; }; if [ -n "${APP_LOCAL_DOMAIN:-}" ]; then ALLOWED_ORIGINS="[\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_DOMAIN}\",\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_LOCAL_DOMAIN}\"]"; else ALLOWED_ORIGINS="[\"${APP_PROTOCOL:-http}://${APP_DOMAIN}\"]"; fi; if [ -n "${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF:-}" ]; then FALLBACKS="[\"${OPENCLAW_FALLBACK_MODEL_REF}\"]"; else FALLBACKS="[]"; fi; if [ -n "${OLLAMA_MODEL_ID:-}" ]; then OLLAMA_MODELS="[{\"id\":\"${OLLAMA_MODEL_ID}\",\"name\":\"${OLLAMA_MODEL_NAME}\",\"reasoning\":false,\"input\":[\"text\"],\"cost\":{\"input\":0,\"output\":0,\"cacheRead\":0,\"cacheWrite\":0},\"contextWindow\":${OLLAMA_CONTEXT_WINDOW},\"maxTokens\":${OLLAMA_MAX_TOKENS}}]"; else OLLAMA_MODELS="[]"; fi; if [ -n "${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL:-}" ]; then MEMORY_SEARCH="{\"provider\":\"ollama\",\"remote\":{\"baseUrl\":\"${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_BASE_URL}\",\"apiKey\":\"${OLLAMA_API_KEY}\"},\"model\":\"${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL}\",\"fallback\":\"none\"}"; else MEMORY_SEARCH="{\"provider\":\"ollama\",\"model\":\"${OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL}\",\"fallback\":\"none\"}"; fi; cfg gateway "{\"mode\":\"local\",\"bind\":\"lan\",\"port\":18789,\"auth\":{\"mode\":\"token\",\"token\":\"${OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN}\"},\"controlUi\":{\"enabled\":true,\"basePath\":\"/rassyclaw\",\"allowedOrigins\":$$ALLOWED_ORIGINS},\"http\":{\"endpoints\":{\"chatCompletions\":{\"enabled\":true},\"responses\":{\"enabled\":true}}}}"; cfg models "{\"mode\":\"merge\",\"providers\":{\"ollama\":{\"baseUrl\":\"${OLLAMA_BASE_URL}\",\"api\":\"ollama\",\"apiKey\":\"${OLLAMA_API_KEY}\",\"models\":$$OLLAMA_MODELS},\"localai\":{\"baseUrl\":\"${LOCALAI_BASE_URL}\",\"api\":\"openai-completions\",\"apiKey\":\"${LOCALAI_API_KEY}\",\"models\":[{\"id\":\"${LOCALAI_MODEL_ID}\",\"name\":\"${LOCALAI_MODEL_NAME}\",\"reasoning\":false,\"input\":[\"text\"],\"cost\":{\"input\":0,\"output\":0,\"cacheRead\":0,\"cacheWrite\":0},\"contextWindow\":${LOCALAI_CONTEXT_WINDOW},\"maxTokens\":${LOCALAI_MAX_TOKENS}}]}}}"; cfg agents.defaults.model "{\"primary\":\"${OPENCLAW_PRIMARY_MODEL_REF}\",\"fallbacks\":$$FALLBACKS}"; cfg agents.defaults.memorySearch "$$MEMORY_SEARCH"; exec openclaw gateway run --allow-unconfigured --bind lan --port 18789
